# @fundar/data-chart-telling

> Svelte 5 plot components (line, area, bar, histogram, heatmap, pyramid, scatter, geo) built on svelteplot, with titles, legends, tooltips, facets, timelines and value labels built in. Plots take pixel `width`/`height`; hover and tooltips are switched on with `tooltip` and a `hover` marker.

Start with the full guide: it lists the mental model, the props every plot shares, the switches and the rules that matter. Runnable examples are type-checked, so copy them as a starting point.

## Guide

- [Full guide](./llms-full.txt): API overview, switches, rules, state hooks (`useFigure`, `usePlot`), markers, theming

## Docs

- [Getting started](./docs/getting-started.md): install, first plot, sizing, data
- [Concepts](./docs/concepts.md): plots, figures, rows and series, channels, shared props
- [Plots](./docs/plots.md): the eight plot kinds
- [Scales](./docs/scales.md): axes and channel scales
- [Styles and segments](./docs/styles-and-segments.md): value labels, frame, gaps, ranges of data
- [Markers](./docs/markers.md): annotations, regions, hover highlight, custom components
- [Transforms and statistics](./docs/transforms-and-statistics.md): stacking, binning, smoothing, regression
- [Tooltip and hover](./docs/tooltip-and-hover.md): tooltip options, hover marker, sync
- [Legend](./docs/legend.md): automatic legend, toggling series, sections
- [Timeline](./docs/timeline.md): player (default) and rule
- [Chrome](./docs/chrome.md): title, caption, header, footer, order, dividers
- [Facets](./docs/facets.md): small multiples
- [Composer](./docs/composer.md): several plots in one figure
- [Reading plot state](./docs/state.md): `useFigure`, `usePlot`
- [Maps](./docs/geo.md): GeoPlot, projections, camera, map markers
- [Theming](./docs/theming.md): configuration, themes, locale, CSS variables
